gloss: to manage; to supervise; to run (an event)

definitions.gloss: to manage, to supervise, to preside over, to run
definitions.explanation: To take charge of and manage an event, ceremony, organization, or process. Implies being the person in overall control who makes sure everything runs smoothly.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}を{取|と}り{仕切|しき}る。
イベントの{準備|じゅんび}は{彼女|かのじょ}が{取|と}り{仕切|しき}っている。
examples.english: She is managing the event preparations.

examples.japanese: {葬儀|そうぎ}はすべて{長男|ちょうなん}が{取|と}り{仕切|しき}った。
examples.english: The eldest son managed all aspects of the funeral.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{式|しき}を{取|と}り{仕切|しき}る (preside over a ceremony)
・{現場|げんば}を{取|と}り{仕切|しき}る (manage the work site)
・{全体|ぜんたい}を{取|と}り{仕切|しき}る (run the whole operation)

USAGE NOTES:
Implies a hands-on management role where the person is actively coordinating and directing. Different from simply being in charge on paper — {取|と}り{仕切|しき}る conveys that the person is actively involved in making things happen. Often used for ceremonies, events, funerals, and business operations.
